description: Query any Malaysian government open dataset by ID from the data.gov.my data catalogue or OpenDOSM (fuel prices, CPI, population, trade and more) with filters, date range, sort and limit.

sort.description: Comma-separated columns to sort by; prefix "-" for descending (e.g. "-date")

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.
